pages.title: Skincare Makeover Makeup Game
pages.creator: Nexifie L.L.C
pages.description:
Skincare Makeover Makeup Game puts you in charge of virtual beauty treatments and makeovers. Work through skin-care tasks such as removing pimples, treating skin problems, and cleaning dirty feet. Use the treatment tools provided in each activity before moving on to cosmetic changes.

Makeup and clothing choices add a styling element to the procedures, so the tasks extend beyond cleaning alone. The levels combine treatment activities with creating a finished appearance for each patient, using the game's tools and makeover options along the way.

pages.title: Meow Block: Color Collect!
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Drag blocks around the board in Meow Block: Color Collect! Work with the cats and colored pieces to make matches and clear the way through each puzzle. Look at which blocks are in each other's way before you move. Changing the order of your swipes can give you space for a match that was blocked.

pages.title: Pyramidz2
pages.creator: StoreRider
pages.description: Slide a whole row or column of Egyptian symbols in Pyramidz2. Line up three matching symbols to clear them and look at what the shift sets up elsewhere on the board. Moving an entire line can put more than one match in reach. This sequel plays faster and gives you more opportunities to chain combinations.

pages.title: Tank Stars
pages.creator: StoreRider
pages.description: Aim a tank gun across a 2D battlefield in Tank Stars. Find a firing angle that sends the shot to the opposing tank and make your move before the other side gets the better of you. Adjust your next shot based on where the last one landed. The game supports battles with friends online and offline.

pages.title: Nine Cards Of Winter
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pick Christmas tiles from a layered layout in Nine Cards Of Winter. Collect three of the same design to remove them from the nine-slot stack. Some tiles become available only after you take the ones in front, so think about which matches a pickup will uncover. A full stack ends the game if you can't clear a set.

pages.title: Animal Royal
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description: Send animals and birds to raid your opponent's meat in Animal Royal. At the same time, keep their animals from getting to your own supply. Different creatures have different strengths and weaknesses, so consider what will help you defend and what can get through on the attack. Try to outmaneuver the other player on both fronts.

pages.title: Mage's Secret
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Merge monsters to build up your power in Mage's Secret. Think about which creatures to combine as you work toward the next task, since each merge changes what you have available. Meet new monsters along the way and work through more than a hundred tasks as you piece together the magician's secret.

pages.title: Money Chaser- City Parkour Game
pages.creator: Funtree Studio
pages.description: Collect money as you run through the city in Money Chaser- City Parkour Game. Dodge traps and use a slide to kick competitors out of the way. Once you have enough coins, take on the boss. The money you've collected becomes your ammunition for that fight, so what you pick up during the run matters when you reach it.

pages.title: Ragdoll Bounce
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: A bigger ragdoll launches your character into the air in Ragdoll Bounce. Click to bounce from platforms and keep climbing. Watch where the ragdoll is coming down and time the bounce so you can continue upward. Missing a platform can send you falling back down, so each landing is a chance to set up the next one.

pages.title: 321 Choose the Different
pages.creator: Vengo
pages.description: Spot the figure that differs from the others in 321 Choose the Different. Quick answers earn more points when you're racing the clock. Try Fast Mode for short decisions, Relax Mode when you want time to compare the options, or Extreme Mode for a tougher test. Look for the detail that breaks the pattern before choosing.

pages.title: Brain Test: One Line Draw Puzzle
pages.creator: boooogiegames
pages.description: Draw each shape in one uninterrupted stroke in Brain Test: One Line Draw Puzzle. Look at where the lines meet and decide where to start so you can get around the whole shape without lifting your finger. As the designs get more complicated, planning how you'll reach the last section can save you from starting over.

pages.title: Exit - Puzzle
pages.creator: KTV
pages.description: Rotate the puzzle to guide a ball out in Exit - Puzzle. Check how a turn will change the ball's route before moving the board, then work it past any obstacles blocking the exit. Later levels give you more complicated layouts to turn. Think about where the ball will end up before you make the next adjustment.

pages.title: Stunt Multiplayer Arena
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Take a car, truck, or van into Stunt Multiplayer Arena. In solo free roam, try frontflips and backflips on dirt or ice and see how the vehicle handles each surface. Switch to the multiplayer survival derby to ram other vehicles and try to stay in the arena as the competition crashes around you.

pages.title: Portal Master
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Turn a villain's shot back on them in Portal Master. Arrange the magic portals so the bullet goes in one and comes out on a path toward the attacker. Look at the direction of the shot before you commit to a placement. The puzzle is working out how to redirect the bullet and protect Stickman.

pages.title: Kingdom Wars TD
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Defend a castle as a commander in Kingdom Wars TD. Put together a group of up to five soldiers, choosing from fighters such as archers, warriors, and priests. Each stage sends two waves against your defense. Think about what the units in your lineup can contribute before the attackers arrive.

pages.title: Baby Penguin Fishing
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Choose between casting a line and throwing a net in Baby Penguin Fishing. In Fishing mode, click a fish to cast at it and catch fish quickly enough to advance. In Trawling mode, pick an area and drop the net to catch everything inside it. Look for a spot that helps you meet the current objective before time runs out.

pages.title: Sorting Sorcery
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Sort pots, crystals, mushrooms, and other magical supplies in Sorting Sorcery. Move the mixed-up items into groups and plan ahead so you can finish without extra moves. Efficient solutions earn a higher score and can net you three stars. The castle has 50 puzzles to work through as you organize its witches' and wizards' supplies.

pages.title: Trick Shot - World Challenge
pages.creator: KTV
pages.description: Land balls in a cup in Trick Shot - World Challenge. Work out where to send the ball and adjust your aim based on how each attempt turns out. There are more than 200 levels to try as you work on your accuracy. Compare your results with other players on the global ranking table.

pages.title: My Secret College Crush
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Help Ellie try out a new look in My Secret College Crush. She's started college with Ben and wants to change up her style after realizing he hasn't noticed her. Put together outfits for Ellie, and choose what the two should wear for an outing if they end up going on a date.

pages.title: Stickman Flip
pages.creator: Active Games
pages.description: Do backflips and see how high you can get in Stickman Flip. Tap to flip while the stickman is airborne and watch his position as he comes back down. Keep the jumps going to reach heights you haven't seen before. The whole challenge comes down to when you tap during each jump.

pages.title: Electro cop 3D
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Chase bank robbers on a police jet ski in Electro cop 3D. Recover the money they've left behind and take it back to the bank. Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer while you pick up loot and shoot at enemies. See how quickly you can finish the chase while still bringing back the money.

pages.title: Deliver It Master
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Carry people and goods to their destinations in Deliver It Master. Tap to play and pay attention to the vehicles that cross your route. Wait for a gap if traffic is about to get in your way, since the delivery only counts if you get there safely. Each new level gives you another trip to handle.

pages.title: Football Brawl
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Outscore your opponent before the clock runs out in Football Brawl. Use the arrow buttons to move and jump, then choose a kick with the ball buttons. Pick up power-ups when they appear and work your way through divisions to unlock rewards. You can also use emotes during a match.

pages.title: Bubble Sorting Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Sort bubbles into groups of four matching colors in Bubble Sorting Deluxe. Move them between tubes until each color has a tube to itself. Easy gives you fewer bubbles and more space, while Hard gives you more bubbles and fewer tubes. Use a reward like an extra tube if you need room to set up a move.

pages.title: Paper Plane Earth
pages.creator: Sleepy Penguin Studios
pages.description: Fly a paper plane around a rotating Earth in Paper Plane Earth. World landmarks come around as the planet turns, and you tap to hop over them. Each clear jump earns points. Watch how quickly the next monument is coming up, because a collision ends the flight and sends you back to the start.

pages.title: Pixel Color Kids
pages.creator: Renan Games
pages.description: Color pictures square by square in Pixel Color Kids. Choose an available pixel image and fill in the design with the mouse or by touching the screen. The grid lets you work on small sections of the picture at a time. You can return to a drawing and color it again whenever you want.

pages.title: Mr Noob Pro Archer
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Fight off enemies with a bow in Mr Noob Pro Archer. Opponents can attack with swords or arrows and appear in different positions as you move through the levels. Line up your shots to clear them, improve your score with each enemy you defeat, and collect the gold you can reach along the way.

pages.title: Basketball serial shooter
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Keep a streak of baskets going in Basketball serial shooter. Bounce the ball on the court or in the air and send it through the hoop. Rebounds, wind, and obstacles affect where the ball goes. Adjust your timing for what's in front of you and see how many baskets you can score in a row.

pages.title: SortPuz Water Sort Color Sorting Game
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Pour colored water between glass tubes in SortPuz Water Sort Color Sorting Game. The puzzle is complete once each filled tube holds only one color. Look at the top layers and decide which pour will free the color you need next. Later puzzles give you more tubes and colors to keep track of.

pages.title: Cute Elements
pages.creator: Xpresate Studio
pages.description: Start with the water element and free the other characters in Cute Elements. Drag, drop, and click to combine their powers as you work with keys and locks. Use what each element can do to beat the levels. Missions offer other goals to complete, and you can unlock costumes, collect elemental cards, and earn trophies.

pages.title: Alien Hunter Bros
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Team up to capture aliens in Alien Hunter Bros. One agent distracts the aliens while the other uses a catcher capsule. Work together to reach spots that are hard for either agent to handle alone. The agents also have different tools, so coordinate when to move, use the laser gun, or throw a trap.

pages.title: Muscle Race 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Collect dumbbells and build enough strength to get through the course in Muscle Race 3D. Walls and swimming pools stand between you and the finish, so gather weights before you try to take on those obstacles. You're racing three computer-controlled players. Move quickly enough to get stronger and still beat them to the end.

pages.title: Happy Trucks
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Estimate how much liquid each vehicle can hold in Happy Trucks. Fill the truck without leaving it short or letting it overflow. A bad estimate restarts the same level, so use the next attempt to adjust how much you pour. There are 30 levels, with a different truck to judge each time.

pages.title: Draw in
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Guess the perimeter of a figure in Draw in. Hold the screen or mouse button to grow a straight line and release when you think it's long enough to wrap around the outline. A line that falls short or extends too far won't fit. Try judging the outline across 75 different figures.

pages.title: Monster Truck Stunt Driving Simulation
pages.creator: WebAvari
pages.description: Drive a big-wheeled truck through mountain routes and narrow off-road tracks in Monster Truck Stunt Driving Simulation. Use W and S to move forward and back, A and D to steer, and Space for the handbrake. Judge the space you have before accelerating into a narrow section or attempting a stunt.

pages.title: Pencil Rush
pages.creator: Gismart
pages.description: Collect colored pencils as you race toward the finish in Pencil Rush. Swipe to guide them around obstacles and pick up more pencils on the course. Hitting an obstacle can end the run, so look for a route that lets you collect colors safely. Use the pencils you bring to the finish to color a picture.

pages.title: Super Candy Jewels
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Swap candy pieces to make matches in Super Candy Jewels. A row of three matching pieces clears them, and larger combinations can help you score and create candy bombs. Check how many candies the level requires and whether you're limited by moves or time. Use a booster if it can help you reach the goal.

pages.title: Challenge the Runners
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race through obstacle courses in Challenge the Runners and try to qualify for the next round. Jump past traps while other runners crowd the route and avoid being eliminated. Play solo against online or computer opponents, or take on a friend in two-player mode. Earn coins through achievements and spend them on skins and characters.

pages.title: RubberBand Cutting
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Free objects wrapped in rubber bands in RubberBand Cutting. Drag the knife across the bands to slice through them and uncover what's underneath. Look for the straps still holding each item in place, then cut through those sections too. You can see more of the object as the layers come off.

pages.title: Snowball Kickup
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Keep a snowball in the air in Snowball Kickup. Time each kick before the ball hits the ground, and watch its size as you go. The snowball gets smaller during play, so swap it for a fresh one when needed. Get the new ball under control and keep the streak going.

pages.title: Car Girl Garage
pages.creator: Sakura Games
pages.description: Help Miriam restore her grandfather's workshop and an old Beetle in Car Girl Garage. Find hidden tools, then follow the instructions at the top of the screen for each repair. The jobs include checking the oil, changing a wheel, replacing a battery, and topping up coolant. Use taps and drags to carry out the tasks around the garage.

pages.title: Mr. Bouncemasters 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Launch a penguin and send it as far as you can in Mr. Bouncemasters 2. Watch how the penguin bounces through each area and work around the obstacles in its way. Upgrade the penguin between attempts to help it travel farther, then compare your best distances with the scores on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Halloween Grand Fest
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare a Halloween spread in Halloween Grand Fest. Use the mouse to work through recipes for pumpkin soup, an eyeball cake, and biscuits shaped like long fingers. Each dish adds something different to the feast, from the soup to the decorated sweets. Follow the cooking steps to get the dishes ready for the celebration.

pages.title: Snow Excavator
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Clear a way out for snowbound residents in Snow Excavator. Move the mouse to steer the vehicle around obstacles while making a route through the snow. Keep an eye on what's ahead so you can get to the people who need help. Upgrade the vehicle as you take on tougher snowstorms.

pages.title: Raft Shark Hunting
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Hunt sharks from a raft or dive below the surface in Raft Shark Hunting. Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and the mouse to fire. Press 1 for Shooter Mode and 2 for Boat Mode. The equipment ranges from spears to firearms, so you have different ways to defend yourself during the hunt.

pages.title: Super Buddy Run
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Run through forests, icy areas, and volcanoes in Super Buddy Run. Jump over blades and mines, avoid creatures such as crabs and bees, and stay out of the water. Collect stars on the route and spend them on items for Buddy. See how long you can keep Buddy running through the different terrain.

pages.title: Sniper Stag Hunter
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Move through a forest hunting ground in Sniper Stag Hunter. Use the arrow keys to move and the mouse to handle the gun. Scan the area as you go and line up a shot once you have a clear view. Where you position the hunter matters when you're trying to aim through the surrounding terrain.

pages.title: Highway Rider Bike Racing: Crazy Bike Traffic Race
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Race motorcycles through highway traffic in Highway Rider Bike Racing: Crazy Bike Traffic Race. The races combine stunt riding with attacks on rival riders. Browse the garage for bikes, outfits, and weapons such as bats, axes, and firearms. Choose a race mode and keep watching the road while dealing with the riders around you.

pages.title: Marvelous Highway Car Stunt Ramp Car Stunt Race
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Drive high-speed stunt routes in Marvelous Highway Car Stunt Ramp Car Stunt Race. Take on ramps, highway obstacles, and jumps involving trains. Look at the approach to each jump before you accelerate so you can line up the car and carry enough speed. The courses put those jumps among stretches of city highway driving.

pages.title: Robin Hook
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Swing from a string in Robin Hook. Tap or click to hook on as you move through a level, then use your swing to get past obstacles and reach the next stretch. Time the next hook before you fall. The challenge is keeping a series of swings going until you make it across.

pages.title: Sea Life Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pair up tiles showing the same sea creature in Sea Life Mahjong. Use the mouse or touch screen to select available matches and remove them from the layout. Look again at the tiles left behind after a match, since clearing one pair can open up another. The level is complete when you've removed every tile.

pages.title: Mahjong Sweet Connection
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Clear matching candies in Mahjong Sweet Connection. A candy must have space on its left or right and nothing stacked on top before it can be paired. Find two available candies of the same kind, then connect them and look for matches you've freed up. Work through the layout and earn stars as you go.

pages.title: Land Vehicles Driver
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Explore the city in one of six vehicles in Land Vehicles Driver, including a tank and a futuristic ride. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys, and press T to get in or out. Switch camera views with C, use the handbrake with Space, and try the lights with L when you head out at night.

pages.title: Extreme Space Airplane Attack
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pilot a spaceship through enemy fire in Extreme Space Airplane Attack. Move with WASD or by swiping with the mouse to stay clear of incoming shots while taking on the attacking ships. Work through several stages and watch for larger enemies and bosses. Keep changing position as new threats enter the screen.

pages.title: 10x10 Blocks Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Fit groups of blocks into a ten-by-ten board in 10x10 Blocks Match. A complete horizontal or vertical line clears and gives you room for more pieces. Place the current three groups before the next set appears. There's no timer, so check whether each shape will still fit before you fill the last useful spaces.

pages.title: Funny Rescue Pet
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Come to the aid of two pets in Funny Rescue Pet. Lica's house has caught fire, and Purry has gotten soaked. Help each pet recover from their accident, then give them a makeover. The two rescues start with different problems, so work through the care each pet needs before moving on to their new looks.

pages.title: Arkadium's Spider Solitaire
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Build runs from king down to ace in Arkadium's Spider Solitaire. Move cards between columns to uncover hidden cards and work toward complete sequences of one suit. Deal more cards when you need them, but leave enough room to rearrange the tableau. The extra deck gives you more cards to manage than in a one-deck solitaire game.

pages.title: Chic Wedding Salon
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Prepare for a wedding in Chic Wedding Salon. Design the bride's nails, choose an outfit, and decorate a room as you work through the preparations. Use the mouse to try different options before settling on the look you want for the occasion. The story follows the wedding plans from one task to the next.

pages.title: Bird Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Guide a bird with physics-based flight in Bird Simulator. Hold Space and S together to take off, then get a feel for how the bird responds once it's airborne. Adjust your movement as you fly through the cartoon setting and listen to the bird sounds. The challenge starts with getting off the ground and staying in control.

pages.title: Halloween Doll Party Fashion
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Mix costume pieces for a trick-or-treat outfit in Halloween Doll Party Fashion. Browse the available items and put together your own Halloween look. Try changing one piece at a time to see how it works with the rest of the outfit, or start over with a different costume idea.

pages.title: Mission To Mars Differences
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Compare two Mars-themed pictures in Mission To Mars Differences. Find seven changes before the minute runs out, then move on to another pair of scenes. Scan one part of each picture at a time to catch the small details as well as the obvious differences. There are ten levels to work through.

pages.title: Duck Hunter
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Aim a shotgun at flying ducks in Duck Hunter. Their speed and direction vary, so adjust your aim as they cross the countryside. Reload when you need another shot and look for the next duck as it comes into view. Check the performance stats to see how accurate you've been over the course of the hunt.

pages.title: Offroad Oil Tanker Truck Drive
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Haul oil to its destination in Offroad Oil Tanker Truck Drive. Handle a heavy tanker on steep uphill routes and keep it under control as the road changes. Give yourself time to line up the truck before a tight stretch or climb. The delivery is complete when the oil reaches the destination.

pages.title: Funny Fishing
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Fish for more than ordinary catches in Funny Fishing. Use the onscreen controls or arrow keys to move and fish, collecting things such as starfish, shells, and treasure along the way. Watch for sharks and look for bubbles carrying bombs or other items. Gather what you can from the water and try to raise your score.

pages.title: Venom Zombie Shooter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight zombies across a series of missions in Venom Zombie Shooter. Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and the right mouse button to aim before firing with the left. Switch weapons with the number keys when you need a different way to deal with the enemies still coming at you.

pages.title: Traffic Car Revolt
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Choose a car and steer around other vehicles in Traffic Car Revolt. Use the arrow keys to guide the car through gaps in traffic and collect gold coins along the road. Look ahead before changing lanes so you have room to get past the next vehicle. Use the coins to unlock other roads.

pages.title: HeX PuzzleGuys
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Connect four hexagons of the same color in HeX PuzzleGuys. Look for pieces that are already close together and work toward joining a group of four. Check the neighboring spaces around a color before you make your move, since the board uses six-sided pieces. The puzzle centers on forming those same-color groups.

pages.title: Angry Bull Fight
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take on attacking bulls in Angry Bull Fight. Use WASD to move and hold left Shift to run. There are two weapons to use across the levels. Watch where the bull is coming from, reposition if you need more space, and use the mouse to aim and fire.

pages.title: Easter Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Assemble Easter pictures in Easter Jigsaw. Drag the pieces into place and earn in-game money from finished puzzles. Use $1,000 of those earnings to unlock another picture. There are ten images and three modes for each one, with the hardest mode awarding more money if you complete it.

pages.title: EG Volley Ball
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Keep a volleyball in the air with your hands in EG Volley Ball. Hit it so it reaches stars and earns points, then watch where it comes down to get ready for another touch. The run ends if the ball hits the ground. Balance going after stars with keeping the ball within reach.

pages.title: Candy Match 3
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Match candies and work through 50 boards in Candy Match 3. Look for combinations that clear more pieces at once and check what they leave behind for your next move. The game includes four power-ups to help with the puzzles. Use them where they can make a difference to the current arrangement.

pages.title: Super Raccoon World
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Help two raccoon brothers gather corn in Super Raccoon World. Avoid monster chickens, scorpions, and other creatures while collecting every piece of corn in a level. Once you have it all, return to the tree hollow. Checkpoints give the brothers a closer place to restart if they run out of health or fail the level.

pages.title: Furious Road Surfer
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Weave around cars and trucks in Furious Road Surfer. Try the different driving modes, including a racing face-off against computer opponents. Use the money you earn to upgrade your ride or buy another car. Keep reading the traffic ahead as your speed rises so you have time to choose a lane.

pages.title: Pixel War
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Grow your population and take over enemy territory in Pixel War. The invaders are spreading too, so decide where you need more pixels and where you can afford to attack. Watch how the balance changes as both sides expand. A move that helps on one part of the screen can leave another exposed.

pages.title: Poop Clicker 3
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Click to produce poop and build up your earnings in Poop Clicker 3. Spend what you've accumulated on upgrades or additional toilets to improve production. Decide when to save for a bigger purchase and when to buy something that helps right away. Keep building up your output as new purchases come within reach.

pages.title: Mermaid vs Princess
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose between an underwater look and a castle outfit in Mermaid vs Princess. Help the princess get ready for a big event by trying dresses that suit each version of her character. Compare the looks as you put them together, then decide whether she should dress as a mermaid or a castle princess.

pages.title: Angry Checkers
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Slide your discs into the opposing pieces to knock them off the board in Angry Checkers. Judge the direction of each shot so you can clear the other side's pieces while keeping your own in play. Face the computer, match with another player online, or share one device with a friend in Hot Seat mode.

pages.title: Crystal Gem Pearl Dress Up Game
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Create a new look for Pearl from the Crystal Gems in Crystal Gem Pearl Dress Up Game. Put together a casual outfit or explore designs based on her regenerations and fusions. Try different combinations to see which details work together. You can style a familiar version of Pearl or make your own interpretation.

pages.title: STOP Trump vs Kim Jong-Un
pages.creator: wopa interactive
pages.description: Pilot an alien ship in STOP Trump vs Kim Jong-Un. In the game's fictional showdown, the alien is trying to keep a war from destroying Earth. Aim with the mouse and click to shoot as the leaders move across the screen. Watch the timer and line up shots while the targets are still within reach.

pages.title: Wothan
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Run along platforms to escape the castle dungeon in Wothan. Use the left and right arrow keys to move your hero and watch what awaits on the next platform. Some platforms slow you down, while others can be destroyed with a hammer. Read the route as you go and see what score you can reach.

pages.title: Gravity Soccer
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Get a soccer ball into the goal by changing what supports it in Gravity Soccer. Click blocks to remove them, then let the ball fall or roll through the opening. Look for a route that also takes it past stars. The order in which you remove blocks determines where the ball ends up.

pages.title: Save the Christmas
pages.creator: ESERGAMES
pages.description: Search for Christmas presents in Save the Christmas. Move through the platform course and use X to jump between sections as you look for the gifts. Check where you can land before you leap, especially when the way ahead is broken up. Use the save and load keys if you want to return to your saved progress.

pages.title: NinjaDash
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Defend a statue by sending ninjas at approaching enemies in NinjaDash. Watch which attackers are getting close and direct your ninjas toward them before they can reach the statue. The fights take place on different tatami mats, with bosses that put more pressure on your defense. Try to stop those enemies while they're still at a distance.

pages.title: Bouncing Birds
pages.creator: Longames TEC Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Bounce from platform to platform in Bouncing Birds. Hold to judge the strength of each jump, then aim for a landing that keeps you clear of spikes. A jump can go too high as well as too short. Try different birds and see how high you can climb before a missed landing ends the run.

pages.title: Shades Of Pink 2
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Help Lara put together a pink-themed look in Shades Of Pink 2. Try different shades for her clothes, then choose a haircut and makeup to go with them. Match the eyeshadow to the style you picked and add a lipstick that brings out her face. Adjust the pieces until the full makeover fits together.

pages.title: Sun Beams 3
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Guide the sun back home in Sun Beams 3. Click clouds to change the route: some disappear, while others blow wind that can push the sun along. Think about which cloud you need first so the sun moves toward the house. Each new layout gives you a different path to work out.

pages.title: Mall Shopping Fever
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Join the girls on a shopping trip in Mall Shopping Fever and help each one find an outfit. Try on different clothes, choose accessories to go with them, and pick a hairstyle that suits the look. Compare the options as you go so each shopper gets an outfit that feels like her own.
